invalidated.detail: The recorded digest is the sha256 of the file's CRLF bytes, not of the bytes committed to git. The record verified only on a checkout that rewrote line endings and failed everywhere else. Corrected at the checkout level by the -text rules added in PR #20; the record itself is left exactly as it was.

note: Evidence records that are known to be invalid and are deliberately retained. A record listed here is never deleted, never re-digested and never counted toward a prerequisite. It is replaced only by a new record under a new identifier, produced by a real measurement.
